analysis.summary: ABS Marine Services Limited reported a strong financial performance for FY26, driven by owned fleet expansion, disciplined execution, and operational efficiency, with total income growing by 75.05% year-on-year to INR322.64 crores. Management highlighted the successful induction of the offshore support vessel Artemis and ongoing plans for further fleet expansion, including taking delivery of an offshore supply vessel. Looking ahead, the company remains optimistic about long-term growth opportunities in the maritime sector supported by favorable demand-supply dynamics and government initiatives like Maritime India Vision 2030. For the upcoming financial year FY27, management guided for a conservative 10% increase in turnover and EBITDA margins to remain in the 45% to 50% band. ABS Marine Services Limited reported consolidated total income of ₹322.64 Cr and a net profit of ₹80.80 Cr for FY26.

guidance.claim: Management expects a 10% increase in turnover for the current financial year FY27 from current levels, assuming all vessels run in the second half.
guidance.quote: As regards the guidance on the top line is concerned, we can expect a 10% increase -- assuming that all the vessels will be running in the second half.

guidance.claim: Management expects EBITDA margins to continue in the band of 45 to 50 percent.
guidance.quote: As regards the EBITDA is concerned, I am sure that currently it is in the band of 45 to 50. I am sure that that will continue.

guidance.claim: The tax rate for FY27 is projected to be around a maximum of 1.5% to 2%.
guidance.quote: Around maximum of 1.5% to 2% in that range.

demand_outlook.claim: Favorable demand-supply dynamics in the offshore vessel market, supported by an aging global fleet and limited new vessel additions, continue to improve utilization levels and charter rates.
demand_outlook.quote: Additionally, favorable demand-supply dynamics in the offshore vessel market, supported by an aging global fleet and limited new vessel additions, continue to improve utilization levels and charter rates across segments.

demand_outlook.claim: Management remains optimistic about opportunities emerging within the offshore and maritime sectors driven by initiatives like Maritime India Vision 2030 and support packages for shipbuilding.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, we remain optimistic about the opportunities emerging within the offshore and maritime sectors.

demand_outlook.claim: ONGC is expected to come out with a tender for about 20 vessels anytime soon.
demand_outlook.quote: ONGC is asking for about 20-vessel tender is going to come.

demand_outlook.claim: Offshore investments are rising steadily across continents.
demand_outlook.quote: Offshore investments are rising steadily across continents

capex_expansion.claim: During H2 FY26, the company successfully inducted the offshore support vessel Artemis into its owned fleet.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of this strategy, during H2 FY26, we successfully inducted the offshore support vessel, Artemis, into our owned fleet, expanding our vessel ownership portfolio and improving our ability to participate in higher-value offshore projects.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is scheduled to take delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Further enhancing our offshore capabilities, we are also scheduled to take delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has spent a total of about $15 million for both new vessels, Hades and MPSV.
capex_expansion.quote: Just a moment. We have totally, we have spent about $15 million for both the vessels.

capex_expansion.claim: The company enhanced its offshore capabilities by taking delivery of a DP2 Offshore Well Stimulation Vessel named AM Passion.
capex_expansion.quote: We enhanced our offshore capabilities with the addition of our DP2 Offshore Well Stimulation Vessel, AM Passion, which has already been deployed under a long-term charter with a leading global energy company.

margins_costs.claim: Total income for FY26 stood at INR322.64 crores, registering a robust growth of 75.05% year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: On a consolidated basis, total income stood at INR322.64 crores, registering a robust growth of 75.05% year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for FY26 increased by 179.17% to INR152.55 crores, with the EBITDA margin expanding sharply by 1,763 basis points to 47.28%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased significantly by 179.17% to INR152.55 crores, while the EBITDA margin expanded sharply by 1,763 basis points to 47.28%.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for FY26 rose by 196.45% to INR80.80 crores, with the PAT margin improving by 1,026 basis points to 25.04%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax rose by 196.45% to INR80.80 crores, with a PAT margin improving by 1,026 basis points to 25.04%.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated total income for H2 FY26 stood at INR183.11 crores, registering a growth of 78.93% year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: During H2 FY26, consolidated total income for the period stood at INR183.11 crores, registering a growth of 78.93% year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: Idle cost for a vessel is approximately $1,700 a day.
margins_costs.quote: So, let's put it as a ballpoint figure, it's about $1,700 a day.

margins_costs.claim: Improved utilization levels, better margin realization, and disciplined cost management contributed to healthy growth in revenue and profitability.
margins_costs.quote: Improved utilization levels, better margin realization, and disciplined cost management have contributed to healthy growth in both revenue and profitability.

orders_capacity.claim: Out of eight owned vessels, five are on long-term charter, two have come out of charter, and one newly acquired vessel is pending dry dock.
orders_capacity.quote: Out of the eight vessels that we own, five of them are on long-term charter, three of them -- two of them have just come out of charter, and third one is just we have acquired, so it has to go into the dry dock and then only come out and then only we put her in the market.

orders_capacity.claim: The company owns a total of 12 vessels, including four smaller vessels operating as pilot boats and security boats on long-term charter.
orders_capacity.quote: No, 12 number is correct. The other four vessels are smaller vessels, they are on long-term charter. They are pilot boat and security boat. Four of them, two of them running in Chennai Port and two of them are running in Ennore Port. So, totally we have a, you know, 12 vessels.

orders_capacity.claim: The company secured over ₹350 Cr in strategic contracts.
orders_capacity.quote: Over ₹350 Cr in Strategic Contracts Secured

capital_allocation.claim: Under the tonnage tax scheme, taxes are paid based on vessel tonnage rather than earnings, and the difference between corporate tax and tonnage tax is mandated to be used for purchasing another vessel within 10 years.
capital_allocation.quote: So, what they do is they tax not as per the earnings, they tax on the tonnage of the vessel. So, this what we do is whatever is, you know, between the corporate tax and the tonnage tax is used as for purchasing of another vessel. And that is mandatory, within 10 years you have to do so much purchase.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that bankers are comfortable with the current debt-equity ratio, and funding is not seen as a problem.
capital_allocation.quote: With Bankers comfortable with the current debt-equity ratio ,we don't see funding will be a problem at this point of time.

risks_headwinds.claim: Forward-looking statements are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties and assumptions that are difficult to predict.
risks_headwinds.quote: Such forward-looking statements are not guarantee of future performance and are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties and assumptions that are difficult to predict.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated they stay committed to building a robust asset base that drives operational efficiency, enhances service delivery, and supports sustainable long-term growth.
management_commitments.quote: We stay committed to building a robust asset base that drives operational efficiency, enhances service delivery, and supports sustainable long-term growth.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
